description: North Atlantic Tropical Weather Outlook is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA | National Hurricane Center. The National Hurricane Center monitors marine weather and indicates the chance that disturbances will develop into tropical storms. For storms that do develop, the site shows predicted paths and storm status. Monitor this site to be aware of the potential for tropical storms and/or hurricanes. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal, Flooding – General, Water Quality. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, People, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
